01 · Valeting

Full Valet

£65About 3 hoursAt your home or workplace

The Full Valet is for a car that needs resetting rather than tidying. It includes everything in the Mini Valet, then the seats, mats and carpets are shampooed and extracted (leather seats are cleaned), the boot is deep cleaned and the interior is cleaned down to the air vents and pedals. The outside gets the same pre-wash, snow foam, hand wash and hydrophobic rinse coating.

Book a Full Valet Not sure? Send photos

Who it's for

  • Cars that haven't been properly cleaned for a while
  • Family cars with marked seats and carpets
  • Lease returns and cars being sold
  • Getting a car up to standard before joining Rebel VIP (the first VIP clean is charged at the Full Valet price)

What's included

Exterior

  • Citrus pre-wash to loosen road dirt
  • Snow foam soak
  • Hand contact wash
  • Door shuts cleaned
  • Fuel cap cleaned
  • Hydrophobic rinse coating

Wheels & tyres

  • Wheels cleaned
  • Tyres dressed

Interior

  • Vacuumed throughout, including mats and boot
  • Dashboard cleaned, including air vents
  • Steering wheel, indicator stalks and interior plastics cleaned
  • Windscreen and interior windows cleaned
  • Foot pedals cleaned
  • Fabric seats shampooed and extracted, or leather seats cleaned
  • Mats shampooed
  • Carpets shampooed
  • Boot deep cleaned

What isn't included

  • Leather deep cleaning and reconditioning (Platinum Valet). The Full Valet cleans leather seats.
  • Roof lining (Platinum Valet)
  • Wheel arches (Platinum Valet)
  • Temporary paint protection (Platinum Valet)
  • Removing swirls or scratches from paint (machine polishing)

Handing back a lease car?

A Full Valet is a sensible step before a lease return or a sale. The interior is shampooed and the outside hand washed, so the car goes back clean. A valet is a cleaning service, though. It won't repair chips, dents, kerbed wheels or scratches, which leasing companies may assess separately. [CONFIRM WITH REBEL: how much notice you need before a return date.]

What to expect

Fabric seats, mats and carpets will be noticeably fresher, with everyday marks lifted and smells removed. Some stains, such as ink, dye transfer from clothing or marks that have been there for years, may fade rather than disappear completely. We'll point out any stain that's unlikely to come out before we start.

Shampooed fabrics will be damp when we finish. They usually take about 24 hours to dry, depending on the weather and temperature.

[CONFIRM WITH REBEL: which service this job was. Swap the photo if it wasn't a Full Valet.]

How the Full compares

Compared with the Mini Valet (£40): the Full adds seats shampooed and extracted (leather cleaned), mats and carpets shampooed, boot deep cleaned, dashboard cleaned, including air vents, foot pedals and indicator stalks cleaned.

Need more than the Full?

The Platinum Valet (£110, about 4–6 hours) includes everything in the Full and adds:

  • Leather seats deep cleaned and reconditioned
  • Roof lining cleaned
  • Wheel arches cleaned
  • Temporary paint protection applied

Full Valet questions

How long do the seats take to dry?

Usually about 24 hours, depending on the weather and temperature.

Will it get rid of dog hair?

Yes. See the Ford Mondeo in our work. Heavy pet hair can cost extra, so send us a photo and we'll confirm the price first.

Will it remove smells?

Yes. The shampoo and extraction removes smells from the seats, carpets and mats.

My car has leather seats. Do I need the Platinum?

Not necessarily. The Full Valet cleans leather seats. The Platinum adds a deep clean and reconditioning, which suits leather that's starting to look dry or tired.
